text: Developing a mobile app involves many important decisions. One of the first is choosing between native development, where you create separate apps for iOS and Android, and cross-platform tools like Flutter or React Native, which allow you to write one codebase for both. This choice affects performance; native apps often feel faster and more responsive, while cross-platform apps have improved greatly. Another critical factor is responsive design, ensuring the interface adapts smoothly to different screen sizes and orientations. Finally, you must publish your app through official app stores like the Apple App Store or Google Play, which review your app for quality and security. A successful launch depends on careful planning in all these areas, from code to store listing.
